endorsements.quote: Measurement of trust and partnership needs to begin with the design stage, with inclusion of patients in the cocreation of research methods and aims central to research success [ 51 ].

unlisted_practices: Conduct research on how disclosure of LLM use by patients, physicians, and health systems affects patient trust and perception.

Use diverse datasets and participants, including varied races, ethnicities, gender identities, English proficiency, and education levels, when researching LLMs as third agents in clinician-patient interactions.
Design, train, and use LLMs in ways that reinforce humanistic collaboration between clinicians and patients, positioning them as tools that augment rather than replace clinician-patient interaction.
Retain a human in the loop for LLM use in clinical care because of the risk of hallucinations.

screen.reason: This is a conceptual framework and perspective paper examining the impact of generative LLMs on clinician-patient relationships, ethical concerns, and recommendations for future inquiry and governance.
